sentences.text: MR LALIT V PATEL, ADVOCATE for the Applicant(s) No. 1 PUBLIC PROSECUTOR for the Respondent(s) No. 1 ==============================================================
ORAL ORDER Heard learned advocate Mr. Lalit Patel for the applicant and learned Additional Public Prosecutor Mr. K. P. Raval for the respondent No.1 State.

The applicant was prosecuted under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and tried in Criminal Case No. 7 of 2000 culminating into the impugned judgment and order of conviction by learned Additional Sessions Judge, Court No. 15, Ahmedabad.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge, Court No. 15, Ahmedabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The report of the Public Analyst, as submitted by learned advocate for the applicant, indicated the offence of misbranding under section 16(1)
Gautambhai Maghjibhai Patel vs State Of Gujarat & on 15 April, 2015 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/94948708/
1 (a)(i) as well as offence punishable under section 16(1)(a)(ii) of the R/CR.RA/173/2015 ORDER Act.
It appears that the sanction was obtained in respect of offence under section 16(1)(a)(i).

entities.text: Gautambhai Maghjibhai Patel vs State Of Gujarat & on 15 April, 2015 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Under the impugned judgment, conviction and sentence was recorded for the offence under the said section i.e. under section 16(1)(a)(i) of the Act.

The contention coming forth from the learned advocate for the applicant is that since the sanction was not obtained with reference to the offence under 16(1)(a)(ii) of the Act, the entire trial was vitiated.

Since learned advocate for the applicant wants to make further submissions, time to surrender for the applicant accused is allowed upto 22nd April, 2015, subject to further orders which may be passed by this court.
In the meantime, NOTICE returnable on 21.04.2015.
Learned Additional Public Prosecutor Mr. K. P. Raval waives service of notice for the respondent No.1 State.
Respondent No.2 shall be served by direct service.
